scenario.zh: 你的数据团队训练了一个需求预测模型，需要快速部署到生产环境供业务系统调用
scenario.en: Your data team trained a demand forecasting model that needs rapid deployment to production for business systems

instruction.zh: 决定如何将模型引入生产环境
instruction.en: Decide how to introduce the model to production

output.zh: 配置已更新：新模型接收少量真实流量，旧版本继续服务大部分请求
output.en: Config updated: new model receives limited real traffic, legacy version serves most requests

output.zh: 配置已更新：新环境完整复制，验证通过后一次性切换全部流量
output.en: Config updated: new environment fully replicated, all traffic switches after validation

instruction.zh: 选择生产环境中重点追踪的指标
instruction.en: Select key metrics to track in production

output.zh: 文档已添加：P95响应时间、每秒请求数、资源利用率仪表盘
output.en: Document updated: P95 response time, requests per second, resource utilization dashboard

output.zh: 文档已添加：实时预测分布对比、标签反馈循环、异常检测阈值
output.en: Document updated: real-time prediction distribution comparison, label feedback loop, anomaly thresholds

instruction.zh: 评估不同运行时对这个模型的适配性
instruction.en: Evaluate runtime compatibility for this model

output.zh: 原生TF支持，自动批处理，适合现有TensorFlow模型快速上线
output.en: Native TF support, auto-batching, suitable for quick launch of existing TensorFlow models

output.zh: 跨框架兼容，优化推理速度，适合多种框架训练的模型统一管理
output.en: Cross-framework compatible, optimized inference speed, suitable for unified management of models from various frameworks

instruction.zh: 最终检查配置文档，准备交付运维团队
instruction.en: Final review of config document before handoff to operations team

output.zh: 文档已整理：包含镜像版本、资源配额、回滚步骤和联系人清单
output.en: Document organized: includes image version, resource quotas, rollback steps and contact list

output.zh: 文档已补充：自动降级逻辑、备用模型路径、告警升级机制
output.en: Document supplemented: auto-degradation logic, fallback model path, alert escalation mechanism

takeaway.zh: Seldon 简化了从训练模型到生产 API 的完整路径，为企业 ML 团队提供标准化部署流程
takeaway.en: Seldon simplifies the complete path from trained model to production API, providing standardized deployment workflows for enterprise ML teams

initial.zh: 模型：demand_forecast_v2 | 环境：生产集群 | 预期QPS：200
initial.en: Model: demand_forecast_v2 | Environment: production cluster | Expected QPS: 200
